questions.question: The perimeter of a square is 124 metres. What is its area?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of the square = 124 meters

**Formula used :**

The perimeter of the square = 4a

Area of the square = a²

**Calculation **

⇒ Perimeter of the square = 4a

⇒ 124 = 4a

a = 31 m

⇒ Area of the square = a²

⇒ Area = 31² = 961 m²

**⇒ Hence, The area of the square is 961 m²**

questions.question: In a partnership firm two partners, Vijay and Praveen are working on an assignment. It will take 12 weeks for Vijay to complete the entire assignment alone, while Praveen will take 8 weeks to complete it alone. Due to work pressure, they decided to work on that assignment on the alternate week basis. In the first week Praveen will work and in the second week Vijay will work and so on. In how many weeks the work will be completed if they work on alternate week basis?
questions.solution:
Given:

Vijay complete the work in 12 weeks

Praveen complete the work in 8 weeks

They work on alternate weeks starting with Praveen 

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency timesTime taken

Calculations:

⇒ Total work = LCM of 12 and 8 = 24

⇒ Efficiency of Vijay = Work / Time = 24 / 12 = 2

⇒ Efficiency of Praveen = 24 / 8 = 3

As they work on the alternative basis

⇒ 1 week = 3 work done

⇒ 2 week = 3 + 2 = 5 

similarly,

⇒ In 8 week = 20 work

⇒ 9 week = 20 + 3 = 23 work

Remaining work is done by Vijay

⇒ Time taken to complete = 1 / 2 = 0.5 week

⇒ Total time taken to complete the work = 9 + 0.5 = 9.5 week

**⇒ ****Hence, The work done on alternative basis will take 9.5 weeks**

questions.question: If 1 + sin θ = m cos θ, then what is the value of sin θ?
questions.solution: **Given:** 1 + sin θ = m cos θ **Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab sec² θ = 1 + tan² θ **Calculations:** As from given part ⇒ 1 + sin θ = m cos θ ⇒ m = 1 / cos θ + sin θ / cos θ ⇒ m = sec θ + tan θ squaring both side ⇒ m² = sec² θ + tan² θ + 2(sec θ)(tan θ) ⇒ m2 = 1 + tan2 θ + tan2 θ + 2(sin) / (cos² θ) ⇒ m2 = 1 + 2tan2 θ + 2(sin) / (cos2 θ) ⇒ m2 = 1 + (2sin² θ)/(cos² θ) + (2sin θ)/(cos² θ) ⇒ m2 = (cos² θ+2sin² θ+2sin θ)/(cos² θ) Applying componendo and dividendo rule ⇒ (m²-1)/(m²+1) = (cos² θ+2sin² θ+2sin θ-cos² θ)/(cos² θ+2sin² θ+2sin θ+cos² θ) ⇒ (m²-1)/(m²+1) = (2sin² θ+2sin θ)/(2cos² θ+2sin² θ+2sin θ) ⇒ (m²-1)/(m²+1) = (2sin θ(1+sin θ))/(2+2sin θ) ⇒ (m²-1)/(m²+1) = (2sin θ(1+sin θ))/(2)1+sin θ)) ⇒ (m²-1)/(m²+1) = sin θ **⇒ Hence proved** 6d:T4fc3,

questions.question: A discount of 20% is given for the purchase of two books by a bookseller and a discount of 25% is offered if a customer buys more than two books. A 10% discount is being offered to all the customers on purchase of one book. An additional 5% discount will be given to students. Sohan, a student of M.Com. in college, bought a book for Rs. 513. What was the marked price of the book?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sohan buys a book of cost Rs. 513

On buying 2 book he get 20% discount

On buying more than 2 book he get 25% discount

On buying 1 book he get 10% discount

For students they get 5% additional discount

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP times (100 - Disocunt%)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Sohan is a student and he buys a book

So, he will get a discount of 5% and 10%

So the Marked Price of the book will be

⇒ MP times 5% times 10% = 513

⇒ MP times (100 - 5%) times (100 - 10%) = 513

⇒ MP times 95% times 90% = 513

⇒ MP = (513×100×100)/(95×90)

⇒ MP = 600

**⇒ ****Hence, The Marked Price of the book** **is Rs 600**

questions.question: A man rows to a place 48 km distant and comes back in 14 hours. He finds that he can row 4 km with the stream in the same time as 3 km against the stream. The speed of the stream is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man row to a place 48 km and comes back in 14 h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Let he move 4 km in x hours in downstream

⇒ Speed = 4 / x

And He moves in upstream

⇒ Speed = 3 / x

According to the question, 

⇒ frac{48} {frac{4} {x} } + frac{48} {frac{3} {x} } = 14

⇒ 12x + 16x = 14 

⇒ x = 1 / 2

⇒ Speed in downstream = frac{4} {frac{1 } {2} } = 8 km/h

⇒ Speed in upstream = frac{3} {frac{1 } {2} } = 6 km/h

⇒ Speed of stream = frac{1(x-y)} {2 } =frac{1(8-6)} {2 } = frac{2} {2} = 1 km/h

**⇒ Hence, Speed of stream is 1 km/h**

questions.question: A sum is deposited in a bank which gives simple interest. The sum becomes 1.25 times in 3 years. If there is a requirement of ₹7,60,000 after seven years, how much amount (in ₹) should one deposit to fulfil the requirement?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum becomes 1.25 times in 3 years

There is a requirement of ₹7,60,000 after seven years

**Formula Used:**

Simple interest = (PRT)/(100)

**Calculations:**

The sum becomes 1.25 times in 3 years

Let he invest be P

⇒ Interest earned = 1.25P - P = 0.25P

According to the formula

⇒ Simple interest = (PRT)/(100)

⇒ 0.25P = (Ptimes Rtimes 3)/(100)

⇒ R = 8.33%

There is a requirement of ₹7,60,000 after seven years, So he has to invest

⇒ Interest earned = 760000 - P

⇒ Simple interest = (PRT)/(100)

⇒ 760000 - P = (Ptimes 8.33times 7)/(100)

⇒ ​​(58.31P )/(100) + P = 760000

⇒ ​​(58.31P +100P)/(100) = 760000

⇒ ​​(158.31P)/(100) = 760000

⇒ ​​P = 480000(Approx)

**⇒ Hence, The amount he has to invest is Rs. 480000**
